facts.text: Binghamton University offers the First-year Research Immersion (FRI) program for first-year STEM students to conduct hands-on research.

sources.title: First-year Research Immersion (FRI) | First-year Research Immersion | Binghamton University
sources.quote: The First-year Research Immersion (FRI) program at Binghamton University empowers first-year STEM (Science-Technology-Engineering-Mathematics) students to make scientific and personal discoveries.
